title: WSJF judge input
description: The file each wsjf-scorer session of the wsjf-scoring workflow reads: <workDir>/judge-input-<level>.json, written by `depscore.py judge-input` (scoring.judge_input) before any session starts. It holds the items to judge at one level and the reference jobs, and no computed value: RR-OE, reachability and WSJF are arithmetic over the dependency graph and are not a session's to see or set.

command.description: The depscore.py command that wrote the file.

source.description: The tracker read the command worked from.

warnings.description: What the tracker read warned of.

items.description: The items the plan names for judging at this level, and no other.

referenceJobs.description: The elaborated Epics: each one's original estimate beside its refined size, the sum of its Tasks' sizes. The size comparison at both levels.

summary.description: The counts, and the sessions the workflow starts: `ids` (Epic level, one Epic per session) or `groups` (Task level, one session per group).

groups.description: An Epic's Tasks keyed by the Epic, or one Task with no Epic keyed by itself with `epic` null.

reason.description: Why the plan judges it: its content changed, or it has no value.

prdPath.description: Epic level: the Epic's PRD file, as the matrix names it; null when the matrix names none, and the Epic is then returned unscored.

sizedFromTasks.description: Epic level: true when the Epic's elaboration is done and its size is the sum of its Tasks' sizes, so no size is judged for it.

epic.description: Task level: the Task's Epic, or null.

ReferenceJob.description: One elaborated Epic whose Tasks are all sized.

estimate.description: The size estimated before elaboration, or null.

refinedSize.description: The sum of its Tasks' sizes.
